title: Finite type relation kernels in a coherent cokernel
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that $\mathcal F$ is of finite type and $\mathcal G$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. For every morphism $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$, every open $U\subseteq X$, every integer $n\geq0$ and every morphism $g:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to(\operatorname{Coker}f)|_U$, the sheaf $\operatorname{Ker}g$ is of finite type. Here finite type means locally generated by finitely many sections, and the cokernel is taken in the category of module sheaves.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian), proof of (3), cokernel paragraph

proof.text: Let g be the map of the finite tuple on U. Epimorphisms of module sheaves locally lift sections. Around each point, shrink U so all finitely many sections lift to G. The image of f is finite type, as an epimorphic image of the finite type F; shrink further to choose finitely many image generators.

On this neighbourhood V let Phi be the finite free epimorphism onto the image and let Psi be the map to G consisting of the image generators and the lifts of the original tuple. In the diagram from the split free sequence to image-G-cokernel, Phi is epi. By coherence of G, kernel Psi is finite type. The snake lemma gives an epimorphism kernel Psi to kernel of the original tuple on V.

An epimorphic image of a finite type module is finite type. These local relation kernels are the restrictions of kernel g, since kernels are sectionwise. The finite local generator data on the neighbourhoods give finite local generator data for kernel g on U.
